title: 端接电源和负载的二端口
statement: 二端口 N 由 R1 = R2 = 2 Ω、R3 = 4 Ω 和电流控制电压源 2i1（“+”在上，i1 为流入 1 端的电流）组成，可以求得它的 Z 参数为 z11 = 8 Ω，z12 = 4 Ω，z21 = 6 Ω，z22 = 6 Ω。
端口 1 接 Us = 24 V、内阻 Rs = 4 Ω 的电源，端口 2 接负载 RL = 4 Ω。利用 Z 参数方程求：从端口 1 看进去的输入电阻 R_in（含 RL）、从端口 2 看进去的戴维宁等效电路（不含 RL），以及负载电压 u2。

questions.ask: 从 1–1' 向右看进去的输入电阻 R_in = ?
断开 RL，2–2' 的开路电压 u_oc = ?
断开 RL，从 2–2' 看进去的戴维宁等效电阻 R_eq = ?
questions.explain: Us 置零，端口 1 只接 Rs：R_eq = z22 − z12·z21/(z11 + Rs) = 6 − 24/12 = 4 Ω。
由戴维宁等效：u2 = 12 × 4/(4 + 4) = 6 V。此时 RL = R_eq，负载获得最大功率 12²/(4 × 4) = 9 W。

hints: 把两个 Z 参数方程和两个端接条件 u1 = Us − Rs·i1、u2 = −RL·i2 联立（i2 从 2 端流入，所以负载电流是 −i2）。
输入电阻：用 u2 = −RL·i2 消去 i2，得 R_in = z11 − z12·z21/(z22 + RL)。输出端的戴维宁电阻同理：R_eq = z22 − z12·z21/(z11 + Rs)；开路电压令 i2 = 0。

en.title: A two-port terminated by a source and a load
statement: Two-port N consists of R1 = R2 = 2 Ω, R3 = 4 Ω and a current-controlled voltage source 2i1 (+ at the top, i1 being the current into terminal 1); its Z parameters work out as z11 = 8 Ω, z12 = 4 Ω, z21 = 6 Ω, z22 = 6 Ω.

Port 1 is driven by Us = 24 V with internal resistance Rs = 4 Ω and port 2 is loaded by RL = 4 Ω. Using the Z-parameter equations, find the input resistance R_in seen at port 1 (with RL connected), the Thevenin equivalent seen at port 2 (without RL), and the load voltage u2.

questions.ask: Input resistance seen looking right into 1–1', R_in = ?
With RL removed, open-circuit voltage at 2–2', u_oc = ?
With RL removed, Thevenin resistance seen at 2–2', R_eq = ?
questions.explain: With Us set to zero, port 1 sees only Rs: R_eq = z22 − z12·z21/(z11 + Rs) = 6 − 24/12 = 4 Ω.
From the Thevenin equivalent: u2 = 12 × 4/(4 + 4) = 6 V. Here RL = R_eq, so the load receives the maximum power 12²/(4 × 4) = 9 W.

hints: Combine the two Z-parameter equations with the two terminations u1 = Us − Rs·i1 and u2 = −RL·i2 (i2 flows into terminal 2, so the load current is −i2).
Input resistance: eliminate i2 with u2 = −RL·i2 to get R_in = z11 − z12·z21/(z22 + RL). Likewise at the output: R_eq = z22 − z12·z21/(z11 + Rs); for the open-circuit voltage set i2 = 0.
solution: **4. Load voltage.** u2 = u_oc·RL/(R_eq + RL) = 12 × 4/8 = **6 V**.
